svg.title: EventZilla data platform — the daily run
svg.desc: Pipeline diagram: the workbook and the scraped web pages land in an S3 bucket; Airbyte loads 55,260 rows into the raw schema; dbt builds the staging, quarantine, star and reporting tables with 43 tests; Great Expectations checks the star schema (15 of 15); only then do the app, the analyst, Metabase and n8n read the figures.
